tier1.text: Each vastus lateralis extends, or straightens, the knee and also keeps the knee stable. The vastus lateralis is the largest of the four quadriceps muscles at the front of the thigh. Of these four, the vastus lateralis lies on the lateral, or outer, side of the thigh.
